decision_cruda.rationale: E595-06 is high grade (15.4 g/t, 256 t, about 127 oz). Este has truck headroom (inflow 36 against 72 t/h). LH-01 is down until about 13:30 likely, and the radio and CMMS agree. LH-08 comes from the cheap preparation heading (1.9 oz/h) and takes 0.53 h to arrive. It loads about 30 t/h from 10:03 to 17:00, roughly 208 t or 103 oz. Heading loss is about 14 oz, so net is about 89 oz. I did not use LH-09 because its heading is critical path (4.0 oz/h). I did not cover C538-03 because LH-05 likely returns at 11:30 and Central is already near truck-limited (inflow 118 against 91 t/h). LH-10 would add little on E595-06, since the ore is nearly exhausted by LH-08.
